motivation: The previous hard-sibling margin treated all scene queries as mutually exclusive and catastrophically removed valid part/whole and attribute evidence. Canonical-negative relevancy is retained as the absolute objectness term; listwise evidence is allowed to suppress a sibling only when the complete local query distribution is itself confident.

properties: the local winning query is exactly preserved
a uniform or fully ambiguous query response is exactly preserved
non-winning queries are suppressed only in proportion to parameter-free normalized entropy confidence
no benchmark label, mask, target RGB, trainable parameter, temperature, or scene branch is introduced
